metadata.title: When you get 1 kill and suddenly think you’re the VALORANT MVP for the day
metadata.description:
I swear I did NOT deserve this kill.
My aim took a coffee break but still got him.
Only VALORANT logic can explain this madness.
Click if your luck ever carried you instead of skill!

Click if your aim ever ghosted but still got the kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #funnygaming #luckshot #shorts
